in_marathi.name: Pradyuman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pradyuman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pradyuman is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pradat' which means 'gift'. The name Pradyuman signifies the gift of a child to the parents, symbolizing the joy and happiness that a child brings to a family. It also represents intelligence, courage, and the nurturing qualities of the parents.
